programme.title: One Strange Rock
programme.desc: A story about the creation and history of the planet, the laws governing it, its shape, the richness of flora and fauna, threats to the natural environment, natural wonders and surprising relationships.Actor Will Smith and people who have had the opportunity to spend time in space will talk about this extraordinary place in the universe.Accounts from astronauts including Mae Jemison, Mike Massimino, Leland Melvin and Chris Austin Hadfield will provide a completely new perspective on Earth.Director Darren Aronofsky and his film crew visited 45 countries and six continents.The photos were taken in, among others, the Arctic, the Himalayas, India and during the annual festival in Tarragona, Spain.Materials recorded on board the International Space Station were also used.In the following episodes, viewers will learn how oxygen is produced, the protective layers of the Blue Planet and the entire sequence of events that led to the creation of life.The topic of death, colonization, destruction, the search for alien forms and human intellect will also be discussed.

programme.title: Africa's River Titans
programme.desc: The second largest continent on Earth is distinguished by an impressive fauna that occurs only in this part of the world.It is crossed by huge water arteries.They shape a diverse landscape and constitute a source of life and shelter.Documentary filmmakers show the extent to which animals depend on rivers.They capture spectacular views.They follow the trail of African giants - such as elephants, hippos, crocodiles and leopards.They take viewers to a world where even the most powerful beings overcome numerous challenges every day to survive.The arena of the fight for survival The filmmakers follow the trail marked, among others, by the Zambezi, the Nile and the Ogowe.Life thrives around these rivers.Herds of elephants bathing, hippos basking in the sun and perfectly camouflaged crocodiles create an image of peace and harmony.However, it can be deceptive.Only the fittest will survive here.The cameras captured, among other things, a hunting scene of a crocodile waiting motionlessly for its unwary prey.Apart from the majestic giants, the film features other, no less interesting characters who chose different survival strategies.Among them are the civet, the silent and elusive leopard, the porcupine, and Africa's largest eagle, called the armed warrior.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: A story about the untamed forces of nature, danger and natural wonders that can be discovered in the wildest regions of America.Viewers, together with the creators of the series, will visit Everglades National Park, the Grand Canyon, Death Valley, Glacier National Park and Hawai'i Volcanoes National Park.Even though all these places seem to be well-known and explored, each of them hides its own secrets.A journey in the footsteps of wild America will go far beyond guidebooks.Areas will be explored where humans are still guests and must absolutely obey the rules of nature.

programme.title: Animal Genius
programme.desc: Biologist Liz Bonnin has been revealing the secrets of the fauna kingdom for years.In this film, he observes animals that are very good at fighting predators, even though they do not have sharp claws and fangs.Their survival is related to skills such as communication and cooperation.It turns out that nature still hides many secrets from us.The observed animals surprise scientists who make new discoveries.This time they will learn patents for survival, including:in Africa and Mexico.There is strength in a herd. Charming meerkats have already been the heroines of many documentaries and TV series.Curious mammals living in the Kalahari Desert are exposed to attacks by predators.They can inform each other about various threats.Their characteristic sound signals are crucial.Viewers will also watch the battle between Matabele warrior ants and termites.Unusual insects can provide first aid to injured companions.In Mexico, Liz Bonnin will observe sea turtles.The small reptiles face a dangerous journey to the ocean.They move towards the water together, increasing their chances of survival.These scenes show that in nature, it is not only the strongest who survive, but also the best connected.

programme.title: Secrets of the Octopus
programme.desc: We discover eight different species of octopuses in the depths of the sea.Each has a unique personality and great intelligence.Despite drastic differences, these animals turn out to be surprisingly similar to humans.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: In this episode we will see animal hunters carefully preparing a battle plan.We will see that an attacker's intelligence can make the difference between victory and death.We will see, among other things, how hyenas hunt and how they deal with the leader who acted to the detriment of the herd.We will also witness a hungry cheetah trying to catch a savannah gazelle.She decides to take a desperate step - she runs away to a river full of crocodiles.They will have a feast, the big cat must enjoy it this time.

programme.title: Untamed Americas
programme.desc: The territory of North and South America stretches over 15,000 kilometers - from the Arctic Archipelago to Tierra del Fuego.No other continent has such breadth and diversity of landscape.Here you can admire the longest mountain chain in the world - the Andes, the Amazon rainforest and the driest area on Earth - the Atacama Desert.Unique species of animals live in these wild areas.The authors hunt grizzly bears, encounter bats with extremely long tongues, jaguars attacking caimans and dolphins swimming among the trees.From cold Alaska, through the tropical Caribbean and the green Amazon - famous actor Josh Brolin takes viewers on this amazing journey.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom: Uprising
programme.desc: The film is dedicated to a lion named Sekekama.He is the undisputed leader of the pack.However, to maintain power, he must defend his throne against his rivals.These are three eastern princes who want to rule the entire territory.They are ready to overthrow the current king, and each of them may pose a real threat to his position.A new, powerful empire is also created by the dangerous Queens of the North.Three lionesses were once expelled from the pride, and now they tirelessly plan bloody revenge on their enemies.Meanwhile, the lioness Saba struggles with a personal tragedy.At the same time, she constantly works to ensure that the only son she has will follow the path she has set In distant Botswana, a fierce battle between the lion dynasty is taking place.Animals conspire, plot, plan coups, commit treason and protect their heirs with dedication.The four-episode documentary series brings to mind dramas whose heroes are people.On the African plains, the story of kings, their traitorous sons and mysterious avengers comes to life.The background of the bloody games are stunning landscapes, captured using the latest filming technology.Viewers can see both lightning in the stormy sky above the plain and individual dewdrops on the lion's mane.Game of Thrones One of the main characters of this story, created five years ago, is the aging lion Sekekama.He must constantly guard his position in the herd.He has enemies even among his descendants.In addition, warrior lionesses appeared on the outskirts of his territory, which the authors of the document called the Queens of the North.Three females and eight cubs are able to create a new dynasty that will take over the area.Saba the leopard will also play an important role in the whole story, as she tries to instill the hunter's instinct in her son and teaches him the art of killing.

programme.title: Europe's New Wild
programme.desc: There is no shortage of impressive metropolises and monuments of civilization on the European continent.Regions free from human interference are particularly valuable here.Past generations have witnessed the extinction of some animal species.The six-episode documentary series contains an optimistic message that nature can regenerate.The filmmakers showed the activities of scientists who are trying to rebuild fragile ecosystems in places such as the Carpathians, Lapland and the Danube Delta.In this episode they will also visit Poland.The return of the wolf, bison and lynx Viewers will learn about the effects of the program to restore the bison population in the Romanian mountains.This species plays an important role in shaping the landscape and influences the lives of other animals.The cameras captured an exciting confrontation between a herd of these majestic deer and wolves.To learn about the situation of dog ancestors, who often fell victim to humans, the documentarians went to Poland.One of the heroes of the episode is a persistent bassist.Released in the Kampinos National Park, the wolf traveled a long way alone - only in the mountains did it find a home.The filmmakers also showed the story of Slovak lynxes, which were used to rebuild the population of this species in Germany.
